column2: A pianist performs a sonata at a grand piano, with an open score and a small attentive chamber audience.
An angry adult strikes the padded seat of a chair with an open palm, without hitting any person.
A person with a stomach ache sits curled slightly forward, pressing one hand over the upper abdomen beside an unfinished meal.
An adult reads a picture book aloud to three children seated closely on a rug.
A hand pushes a floating wooden block below the surface of a clear water basin, creating small bubbles.
A ticket dispenser presents three connected tickets marked only “998”, “999” and the highlighted final serial “1000”.
Two craftspeople demonstrate their close working connection by fitting the two halves of one wooden bridge together.
A pair of opaque blue tights hangs neatly from a waistband clip, with both connected legs and feet visible.
A long paper timeline presents seed, sprout and mature-tree event pictures in chronological order along one continuous line.
A person holds a sore cheek beside a half-eaten apple while a dentist gestures toward an examination chair.
A smooth torus-shaped solid rests on a tabletop, clearly showing its continuous rounded ring and central opening.
A painter makes a tiny touch-up to a chipped patch on a nearly finished chair with a fine brush.
A customer trades in an old bicycle at a shop counter while choosing a newer bicycle behind the salesperson.
A skilled tradesman carefully fits a wooden door into its frame using a plane, square and chisel.
A pink ballet tutu is displayed on a dress form, with its short layered skirt spreading evenly around the waist.
A rope-maker twists three loose fiber strands together into one tight cord using both hands.
A hoofed animal lifts one front foot, exposing its solid horn-covered hoof above the grass.
The last visitor leaves a theater as the attendant closes the doors behind the now-empty rows of seats.
A person opens two windows to ventilate a room, with light curtains moving inward beside a drying towel.
A wanderer walks along a remote footpath carrying a small bedroll and a worn pack.
During wartime, civilians shelter in a reinforced room while a medic tends an injured adult without visible blood.
A warthog stands beside dry grass, displaying curved tusks, cheek warts, a bristly mane and a thin raised tail.
A brown weasel peers from a stone wall gap, showing its slender body, short legs and pale underside.
A craft worker proudly inspects a well-made wooden cabinet whose doors fit cleanly and smoothly along every edge.
A gardener studies a small house model beneath a pictorial thought bubble containing the same house under a heavy raincloud, with no words.
A wind-up toy car rests upside down with its winding key and compact spring mechanism clearly visible.
A presenter wraps up a meeting by gathering scattered picture cards into three clear main-point groups on one board.
A reporter prepares a newspaper article beside an event photograph, with columns of indistinct marks instead of readable text.
A shaggy yak stands on a cold mountain slope, with long dark hair hanging below its belly.
A child performs a yo-yo trick, letting the round toy spin at the end of a taut string.
A zoologist observes small animals through binoculars near a field station, keeping careful picture notes on a clipboard.
A foul-smelling bin of spoiled food repels a passer-by, who wrinkles the nose and leans away.
One worker's desk remains repeatedly empty while colleagues handle a growing pile of shared work beside it.
An accuser addresses a criminal court from the claimant's table while the judge listens and the defendant sits opposite.
An acoustical engineer positions soft wall panels around a recording room and checks a speaker beside a microphone.
An aerobics instructor leads three adults through energetic synchronized steps with raised arms in an exercise studio.
A student of aeronautics studies a model airplane inside a small wind tunnel, watching airflow ribbons over the wing.
A guest adopts an exaggeratedly refined pose, holding a tiny cup with a raised finger while others exchange puzzled looks.
A recovering patient takes gentle after-care exercise with a caregiver beside a sunny window and a comfortable resting chair.
An ageless fantasy tree spirit appears youthful beside a gigantic ancient tree with deeply weathered bark and old stone ruins.
A large agricultural business coordinates a grain field, harvesting machine and produce-loading warehouse within one continuous farm scene.
An agronomist examines crop roots and soil in a field, holding a sample beside healthy planting rows.
A painful blister ails a walker, who pauses to inspect the sore heel beside removed boots.
A pilot wearing a flight headset sits in an airplane cockpit with hands on the controls.
A team of outstanding athletes gathers for an all-star match, each carrying equipment from the same sport and acknowledging cheering spectators.
A parent allays a frightened child's worry by kneeling down, offering a reassuring hand and checking the harmless shadow together.
A librarian arranges three book spines labeled only “A”, “B” and “C” in that alphabetical order on a shelf.
Two small craft workshops amalgamate by combining their tools and staff around one shared workbench.
An amalgamated organization now works around one large table where two formerly separate groups combine their equipment.
A guest enjoys a useful hotel amenity: a clean shower area with neatly supplied towels and toiletries.
A ball-and-stick amino group has one blue nitrogen joined to two white hydrogens and a gray carbon attachment, marked only “NH2”.
An anatomist places the heart correctly between the lungs inside an open torso model, keeping the organ relationship clear.
A person stands before a doorway and prepares to enter, with the threshold directly ahead of both feet.
A cleaner applies antibacterial soap while washing both hands thoroughly above a basin of running water.
A freshly baked savory pie looks appetizing beside a cut wedge, steam rising from its golden crust.
A newly appointed committee member receives a seat and folder from the chairperson while the other members welcome them.
A friendly shopkeeper leans forward with an open smile and relaxed hands as a hesitant customer approaches.
An arcane locked cabinet contains unusual antique instruments and glowing crystal objects examined by a curious scholar.
An archaeologist brushes dust from pottery fragments beside the foundations of an ancient stone building.
Two engineers debate an arguable bridge design, each pointing to a different part of the same model.
An opera singer performs an aria alone at center stage, with an orchestra visible below the stage edge.
A beetle shows the defining arthropod features: segmented body, jointed legs and a hard outer covering on a leaf.
A confident speaker shows assertiveness by standing upright, making a clear calm gesture and maintaining eye contact during a meeting.
A sailor looks astern over the boat's stern toward the wake trailing behind the vessel.
An asthmatic adult sits upright and uses a personal inhaler, with a caregiver calmly waiting nearby.
A clinician inspects a noticeably wasted calf after a leg cast has been removed, without wounds or diagnostic labels.
A calm fantasy figure has a soft luminous aura surrounding the body, with the glow remaining close to the silhouette.
An automaker's factory assembles a car body on a production line, with workers fitting doors and wheels.
A fictional avenger confronts a villain who still holds the stolen family crest, keeping weapons lowered and showing no injury.
A backer supports a young inventor by placing tools and funds beside the inventor's working model.
A flood brings calamity to a village street, with damaged carts and residents carrying belongings toward higher ground.
A stubborn mule balks and stops in the middle of a narrow path while its handler gently pulls the lead.
A boastful storyteller makes an absurd claim with an enormous fish-shaped gesture while skeptical listeners shake their heads.
A sealed old poison vial sits in a locked cabinet, with a gloved keeper carefully preventing access.
A minister baptizes an infant with a small amount of water above a font while the parents stand close.
A plain military barrack contains rows of simple beds, lockers and neatly stored boots beneath open windows.
A low ancient burial mound has a stone-lined entrance and grassy sides rising above the surrounding field.
A rolling cart bashes into a wooden crate, knocking loose its lid and scattering a few apples.
A cat basks in a warm patch of sunlight beside a bright window, stretching comfortably across the floor.
A well-fed farm animal grows plump beside a full feeding trough, showing a broad rounded body.
A clear shallow beck winds between mossy stones beneath a small wooden footbridge in a meadow.
A child befriends a lonely newcomer by offering a seat and sharing a box of colored pencils.
A father gently cradles his newborn child while the other parent rests beside them in a family room.
A beholder studies a landscape painting closely in a gallery, hands relaxed behind the back.
A pleading child holds clasped hands toward a parent, with an earnest face and an overturned bicycle beside them.
A bisexual pride flag has horizontal pink, purple and blue bands, folded beside a matching small identity pin.
A patient traveler bides quietly on a station bench, holding a closed book and waiting beside a suitcase.
A billiards player aims a cue across a green table toward three smooth unnumbered billiard balls.
An annual calendar has twelve month cells numbered only 1 through 12, with alternating months clearly circled for an every-two-month event.
A bingo player places a red counter on a numbered square completing a straight row across a single bingo card.
A biochemist examines a protein model beside test tubes and a laboratory microscope on one clean bench.
A scientist, doctor and patient discuss a sealed specimen and a consent form together around one table with equal seating.
A health statistician points to one annual record showing a population icon marked “1000” and a cradle icon marked “12”.
A music-industry professional coordinates a recording session, with a singer in the booth and sound equipment at the desk.
A worker blackens a pale wooden panel with dark stain, leaving a clear newly blackened section under the brush.
A concentrated cleanup campaign brings many volunteers together to clear litter from one park in a coordinated effort.
A boastful child proudly compares an oversized trophy with classmates' modest achievements while pointing repeatedly at himself.
Dark gathering clouds and bending tree branches bode a storm above a small harbor of tightly moored boats.
Old-style artillery bombards an empty stone fort, with distant impacts in the wall and no people injured.
A miniature bonsai tree grows in a shallow ceramic pot, with carefully pruned branches and a thick curved trunk.
Displeased adult spectators boo a poor stage performance, cupping hands around open mouths without written speech bubbles.
A fabric bookmark lies between the pages of an open book, with its tasseled end hanging below the binding.
A large bower anchor rests on a ship's bow roller, with a heavy chain attached through its ring.
A brackish tidal estuary lies where a winding freshwater stream meets the sea among reeds and low coastal plants.
A fingertip reads a line of raised Braille cells on a cream page, with the six-dot cell structure clearly visible.
A manipulative leader drills seated followers before a large self-portrait while guards close the room's curtains and block the exit.
An isolated recruit listens to relentless indoctrination in a guarded room filled with repeated leader portraits, looking exhausted and passive.
A performer brandishes a wooden practice sword in a broad overhead swing, with clear space around the moving weapon.
A noisy tavern brawl has adults pushing and grabbing each other as a bystander tries to separate them; no blood.
A metal brazier holds glowing coals on short legs, with a kettle warming safely above the rim.
A shopkeeper's balance scale holds equal coin stacks representing income and expenses beside an open business ledger.
A traveler stops in breath-taking wonder at a vast waterfall dropping into a deep green mountain gorge.
A brewer checks a large brewing vat beside grain sacks, copper pipes and a wooden barrel.
A buff leather coat hangs from a peg, showing its thick yellow-tan surface, broad sleeves and plain fastening straps.
A bungee jumper hangs from a secure elastic cord above a river gorge, with the cord stretched and the body fully visible.
A close view of a coat shows a stitched buttonhole beside its matching round button and folded lapel.
Candlelight gently illuminates a small reading table, with one candle flame casting warm light over an open book.
A regional government office stands beside a relief map divided into adjoining administrative districts, with its own canton highlighted blue.
A glass of carbonated water releases many small bubbles rising from the bottom to the surface.
A cardiologist studies a heart model while listening to an adult patient's chest with a stethoscope.
A carefree traveler relaxes in a hammock beside a packed picnic basket, smiling with both hands behind the head.
A cartoonist draws an expressive original character on paper at a desk scattered with pencils and simple sketches.
A catchy tune makes a passer-by tap a foot and hum along while a street musician plays a bright melody.
Party members gather in a caucus around a long table to discuss candidate portraits and cast simple unmarked voting slips.
A prehistoric celt axe blade rests beside a wooden haft, showing its polished wedge shape and broad sharpened cutting edge.
A ceremonious host bows formally while presenting a small gift on a tray with both hands.
A sealed sample ampoule contains a tiny cesium specimen in a protective case, identified only by the chemical symbol “Cs”.
A restless horse champs at its metal bit, working the mouth while a handler steadies the bridle.
A fervently patriotic crowd waves matching fictional national flags while a speaker dismisses outsiders with an exaggerated superior gesture.
A shopper is pleased by a cheap everyday bowl offered for just a small coin beside the shopkeeper's open palm.
An open checkbook shows attached blank checks with faint form lines and a matching stub section, without readable banking information.
A checkerboard has alternating dark and light squares with round red and black playing pieces arranged on it.
A checkered cloth covers a small table, showing evenly repeated crossing squares in two contrasting colors.
A mother rests in a birthing room holding a newly born baby while a midwife offers a warm blanket.
A choreographer demonstrates a precise arm movement to three dancers who copy the same pose in a studio.
A hungry worker chows down on a large sandwich at a lunch table, holding it firmly with both hands.
A minister christens a baby above a baptismal font while the parents watch the gentle application of water.
A climbing vine cleaves firmly to a stone wall, with small attaching roots holding the stems close to the surface.
A clothesline stretches between two posts with shirts and towels held by simple wooden clothespins in a light breeze.
